objective: truth-free smartphone trajectory correction using only observable GNSS features

road_network_map_matching.reason: No local OSM, road graph, map tile, or route geometry asset was found. External acquisition is outside this local-only phase and would make the experiment non-reproducible.
search_scope: repository files for osm, road, map, graph, tile

observable_feature_model.reason: device_gnss.csv contains handset WLS ECEF, satellite ECEF/quality, carrier-state, clock, and epoch observables; NumPy is available locally.

dependencies.scikit_learn: not required by the frozen implementation

candidate.base_lane: truth-free handset WLS ECEF, exact device epochs
candidate.implementation: NumPy closed-form ridge; no random state, no learned route/device identifiers, no interpolation
candidate.standardization: training-column mean and population standard deviation; zero scale replaced by 1.0; statistics are fit only on the other train routes in each LOO fold
candidate.fit: solve((X'X + alpha I) beta = X'Y) after standardized features; intercept is the training residual mean
candidate.target: truth ECEF minus handset WLS ECEF, one residual vector per exact timestamp

observable_feature_contract.missing_observable_policy: finite aggregate only; absent aggregate uses fixed zero plus no separate learned state; an invalid WLS epoch is omitted by the existing WLS integrity contract
observable_feature_contract.output_contract: same finite timestamp key set as the base WLS lane; candidate failure falls back to the base WLS row and never synthesizes a key

fixed_split.unused_split_policy: fresh validation and future holdout are selected from central metadata only; neither payload nor truth is read before the preceding gate
fixed_split.train_evaluation: leave-one-route-out; each held-out train route is scored only by a model fit on the other six train routes
fixed_split.validation_order: seal truth-free validation artifact before opening fresh-validation truth once
fixed_split.holdout_order: materialize/open future holdout only after a passed frozen fresh-validation gate; no post-holdout tuning or rerun

train_loo: all seven held-out route availability and truth coverage non-regression
all seven held-out route horizontal P50, horizontal P95, vertical P95, and each of four official diagnostic variants non-regression within 1e-6 m
strict aggregate horizontal P95 improvement and strict aggregate four-diagnostic mean improvement
fresh_validation: availability and truth coverage non-regression within 1e-6
horizontal P95 and each diagnostic variant non-regression within 1e-6 m
vertical P95 non-regression and fixed existing profile threshold
strict horizontal P95 or diagnostic mean improvement
promotion_gate.holdout: same sealed gate is evaluative only; no code/parameter change is allowed after opening
promotion_gate.fail_action: record No-Go and retain no production integration

data_leakage_policy.training_truth_allowed_only: ground truth for the seven fixed train routes after feature artifacts are sealed

notes: This record is created before implementation and before any new truth file is opened.
The previous TDCP candidate is retained as a recorded No-Go and is not used for tuning.
The previous public/private leaderboard values are not used for selection, fitting, or ranking.
